title: Open Kick in theatre mode
question: How do I open Kick streams in theater mode?
answer: Kick has no setting to open streams in theatre mode. The theatre button in the player and the T key switch it on, but every new page opens in the normal layout again. The usermods script on this page presses T for you once when a stream or VOD opens, so the player starts in theatre mode. Press T again to leave it on that page; the next stream you open starts in theatre mode again.
prompt: Open every Kick stream and VOD in theatre mode.
details: Kick marks the layout with a `data-theatre` attribute and toggles it from a T key handler on the document. Once per page, when the player (`#video-player`) is on screen and `data-theatre` is `false`, the script sends that key press. It does not fight you: leave theatre mode and it stays off until you open another stream or video. The check runs on a VOD page; live channel pages use the same player.

alternatives.title: Theatre button or the T key
alternatives.body: The theatre button at the bottom right of the player, or **T** while the page has focus, switches theatre mode on for the current page. Kick does not remember it after a reload.

check.intact: (() => { const v = document.querySelector('#video-player'); return !!v && v.checkVisibility() && v.getBoundingClientRect().width > 1000 && v.readyState >= 2; })()
